oracle: 1000 area-stratified mesh surface points, exhaustive analytic plane contacts, GPU AVBD; not the paper grid-sample set
rolloutIsolation: backend emits only drop-to-floor contacts (floor slot 0, dynamic slots 1..N)
conventions: released parameters; per frame, the deepest source-mesh vertex below the ground plane per rollout (penetration), and below the solver rest gap margin-allowedPenetration (intrusion), then the mean and max over rollouts. Drop height: lowest vertex 0.25 m above the ground; random orientations shared by all configurations.
contactPolicy: one AVBD constraint per active sample, no manifold reduction; paper reference contact reduction is unspecified
sampleCoordinates: solver body-local source mesh geometry: COM centered, scaled and principal-axis rotated
